lines.zh: 我六条腿一起动，沙地陷下去。
lines.en: Six legs move and the sand sinks.

lines.zh: 我身上的甲片一节一节动。
lines.en: The plates on my body shift segment by segment.
I walk the crest of the dune.
My mandibles never stop grinding.
I push the sand aside.

lines.zh: 我绕开一块风化的石头。
lines.en: I go round a weathered stone.
I keep very low to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的六条腿上都带着刺。
lines.en: There are spines on all six of my legs.

lines.zh: 我从虫巢的方向走过来。
lines.en: I come from the hive's direction.
I stand with my legs spread wide.
I lower my head and wait.
Sand patters lightly on my shell.
My legs never stop twitching.
Something moves at the hive.
I needn't hide from the sun.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳里，等离子在响。
lines.en: Plasma hums inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我身上的刺一根根竖着。
lines.en: My spines stand up in rows.
When the wind stops, I hear it.

lines.zh: 我把一条前腿悬在沙面上。
lines.en: I hold one foreleg above the sand.
A low hum comes from the hive.
I turn my head into the wind.
You stand in the swarm's path.

lines.zh: 我的六只眼睛都对着你。
lines.en: All six of my eyes are on you.
I lower my head and sniff the sand.
We never step back.
I open and close my mouthparts.
I'm still waiting for you to move.
This sand belongs to the swarm.
Back off and I'll let you go.
I press my shell to the sand.
My shadow is black.
Your boots are sunk in the sand.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢别人走近虫巢。
lines.en: I don't like anyone nearing the hive.
Your hands haven't moved.
Seven steps left — I'm counting.

lines.zh: 这里的沙很松，你跑不快。
lines.en: The sand is loose; you can't run fast.
I'm waiting to see your back.
A crack opens in my shell.
I give half a step, legs still braced.
A leg short, and still standing.
My fluid drips into the sand.
I make a low sound.
I turn the wounded side away.
My mouthparts won't close.
I shudder once and plant myself.
I can still walk like this.
Did that come from the hive?
I only lift a foreleg.
The swarm doesn't eat that.
You throw it on the ground.
I push it aside with a leg.

lines.zh: 这味道不像虫巢的东西。
lines.en: It doesn't smell of the hive.
The swarm doesn't eat this.
My feet don't pause once.
It's buried in the sand.
I don't even slow my feet.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，我的甲响了。
lines.en: You hit me and my shell rings.
Six legs brace and hold.
That shifts me half a step sideways.

lines.zh: 我把你推开，没用多少力。
lines.en: I shove you off without much force.
I lower my head, mouthparts working.
I return to my line.
You didn't move me.
I shake the sand off my shell.
Her glow is dimmer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在沙丘背后靠在一起。
lines.en: We come together behind the dune.
Her legs are thinner than mine.
Our antennae touch.
There are three lines of prints in the sand.
We speak only with our antennae.
There's a chip in her shell.
We head toward the hive.
This dune is ours to patrol.
She goes into the tunnel first.
It crumbles in my grip.
I push it into my mouthparts.
This is far too soft.
I drop it on the sand.
There's another smell on it.
I hold it before my mouthparts.
The sand covers it at once.
I don't give it another look.
You finally moved.
Plasma churns in my shell.
I lift my forelegs higher.
The swarm never lets anything go.
I start my legs toward you.
The sand gives under me.
My mouthparts open wide.
You've backed below the dune.
There's no way out that side.
I have you pinned in my sight.
I lower myself, and lower.

lines.zh: 这一下我要压到你身上。
lines.en: This time I'll come down on you.
All you can do now is run.

lines.zh: 我的一条腿已经抬起来。
lines.en: One of my legs is already raised.
A dune won't stop me.
I follow without pausing.
Six legs move as one — faster than you.
The sand slows my stride.
I go round the far side of the dune.
You're between me and the hive.

lines.zh: 我把前腿抬到你胸口那么高。
lines.en: I raise my forelegs to your chest height.

lines.zh: 你已经把手抬起来挡了。
lines.en: You've already put your hands up.
I press in, jolt by jolt.
You've backed to a stone.
I knock the stone away.
There are only a few steps left.
So I come down.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，虫群听见了。
lines.en: Your breathing broke rhythm; the swarm heard.
I bring my whole body down.
This one finishes it.
I've got you pinned down.
My forelegs hack down.
My mouthparts bite your shoulder.
That knocks you down.
My spines rake your leg.
Your blade skids off my shell.
You struggle beneath me.

lines.zh: 又补了一下，等离子还烫。
lines.en: Another hit. Plasma's still hot.
You've finally stopped moving.
I raise my mouthparts.
I draw my forelegs back.
Your blood soaks into the sand.
The swarm will come for the rest.
I turn back toward the hive.

lines.zh: 沙里钻出一个黑色的头。
lines.en: A black head pushes up out of the sand.

lines.zh: 我的六条腿一条条伸出来。
lines.en: My six legs come out one by one.
The plates lock segment to segment.
I shake the sand off.

lines.zh: 虫巢的方向有低低的声音。
lines.en: There's a low sound from the hive's direction.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看了看这片沙。
lines.en: I raise my head and look over the sand.
I open my mouthparts for the first time.
Wind ridges run across the dune.
I try a few shuffling steps.
My legs sink deep.
Something warm is far off.
Wind blows sand onto my shell.
I straighten my legs one by one.

lines.zh: 这里的每道沙脊我都记着。
lines.en: I know every ridge of sand here.
I begin patrolling this stretch.
The sun bleaches the sand white.
I climb the highest dune.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的甲，我往沙里钻。
lines.en: Fire catches my shell and I dig into the sand.
I roll down the dune.

lines.zh: 冲击掀起一层沙子盖住我。
lines.en: The blast throws a layer of sand over me.
Something lodges in a seam of my shell.
Too starved to hold my legs up.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，甲都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my shell lights up.
